title: Course Director UX UI and AI
description:
You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire.Â The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name theÂ ten leading designersÂ who should be teaching the worldâs best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.

We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the worldâs leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, yourÂ Team Lead, our otherÂ Course Directors, and theÂ Education Designers, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look atÂ where design and AI are heading, what designers needÂ that nobody has taught well yet, andÂ what we should retireÂ because the field has already moved on.

  • Find the people who should teach it.Â You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

  • Decide what each expert should teach.Â The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

  • You'll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

  • Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager.

  • Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants. Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You'll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You'll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team.

  • Make an impact as you pressure-test the coursesÂ our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what's missing, what doesn't belong, and where the structure can be improved.Â You know the limits of your own expertise, and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You'll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them.

  • You're one of the peopleÂ whose judgment the rest of the team leans on.Â You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You'll work in aÂ diverse, highly organized, result-driven environmentÂ where you'll grow personally and professionally.

  • Act as guardian of our quality bar. When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you're the one who spots what's not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it.

  • Bring your subject matter expertiseÂ to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish.

  • You help produce Master Classes. We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â Timelines vary enormously:Â with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Education Designers and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • Focus on what mattersÂ as you take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

  • Design for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, a course will serve both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

  • Give the video teamÂ constructive feedbackÂ on course and Master Class videos, from on-screen text and b-roll to graphics and animation, so each video is engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective.

  • Fly out and meet the global industry leaders in design in professional studios across the world.Â You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On averageÂ we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Expect to have several courses moving at once at different stages: one you're planning with an expert, one being shot, one in production, and one published course that you're reviewing and improving.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

  • Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • We're proud to have assembledÂ a remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

About You

  • You have at leastÂ 10 years of hands-on design experience. Thirty is not too many.

  • You have aÂ network among designers you respect, and you'reÂ comfortable writing to someone you admireÂ and presenting them with an opportunity.

  • You know what the design community wants to see, and what it needs to learn.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathy toÂ engage well with very different kinds of people. Much of this job is convincing busy, accomplished people that what we're building is worth their time.

  • You can show us something you built or led: a product, a design team, a course, an AI teaching app, or a conference track. We're excited to hear what it was, your thinking behind it, how long it took you to create, what went wrong, and how you improved it.

  • You can take aÂ broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequenceÂ that'll make a beginner feel and act confident. You can look at a plan for teaching something andÂ see what's missingÂ before anyone builds it.

  • You're aÂ practical idealist. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

  • Youâre aÂ forward thinkerÂ who isnât afraid to innovate and try new things before others have.

  • YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, so theÂ outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

  • YouâreÂ eager to help people build UX and UI skillsÂ because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You canÂ teach a career changerÂ the powerful skills of great design, and you canÂ guide an experienced designerÂ in upskilling. Perhaps you've mentored people, or youâve run your own company helping clients level up.

  • YouÂ give constructive feedback people can act on, and you can tell a talented colleague how they can improve their work without them becoming defensive.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education.

  • You'reÂ fluent in written and spoken EnglishÂ and you can explain complex ideas clearly.

  • Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

  • You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

  • Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

  • If you still love designing in Figma and building interfaces with AI, there's room for that here. Some of our Course Directors design hands-on; others have moved fully into direction. Both work for us.

  • Most of the work happens from yourÂ home office,Â but you'reÂ willing to travel a few times a yearÂ to shoot courses.

  • You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe.

Bonus Points

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

  • You'veÂ led a design team.

  • YouÂ publish your own thinking on design: articles, a book, educational material, a blog, or a social media presence.

  • You'veÂ spoken at design conferences, or you're on a first-name basis with people who do.

  • You'veÂ created design systems. Organizing complex material so other people can put it to use is a lot of what you'll be doing.

  • You've worked as anÂ editor, or you've createdÂ online courses.

  • You have the graphic design skills to create image-based and interactive content for courses, articles, and social media.

  • You'veÂ built AI-supported learning toolsÂ yourself, or you've used AI to build products.

  • You hold aÂ bachelor's or master'sÂ degree in UX, UI, HCI,Â AI, or a similar field.

  • YouâveÂ collaborated with video production teams.

What We Can Offer

  • A highly valued role: You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

  • Reach and impact that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field.Â A design leader might shape the work of thirty people on their team. Your decisions about what we teach will reach hundreds of thousands. They'll build better careers and design a better world for all of us.

  • Access:Â the designers you'd normally see on a conference stage are the people you'll email, plan with, and sit across from in a studio. Our name opens doors. An email from IxDF gets read, so the reach you have now is the floor, not the ceiling.

  • Autonomy: Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in.

  • A global, purpose-driven team: work remotelyÂ alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by aÂ common missionÂ to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone.

  • Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

  • AÂ full-time positionÂ within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or for a studio production.

  • Bi-weeklyÂ knowledge-sharing sessionsÂ and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

  • A work culture with noÂ fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama. Your colleagues valueÂ your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

  • A daily mission to help impact,Â empower, and enrich the lives of millions of peopleÂ by creatingÂ affordable high-end design educationÂ for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

  • Colleagues with four to forty years of experience, and a culture where we follow the best idea, not the longest rÃ©sumÃ©.

  • A companyÂ where the distance between idea and execution is minimal.Â We're a highly agile organization withÂ zero bureaucracy or corporate politicsÂ â and withÂ exceptional order and efficiency.

  • A company culture whereÂ passion meets high performance and excellence. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process,Â you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline.

  • We thrive because we have aÂ hands-on attitude and a bias towards actionÂ as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll needÂ crisp execution skills yourselfÂ and the ability toÂ impress your colleagues with concrete results, just like they'll impress you.

  • We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at theÂ forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it. You'll helpÂ set a directionÂ that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.

title: Product Manager (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. Nobody has really figured out what reliability means for this kind of software yet. That's the problem you'd own.

What you'll do

As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for empowering developers and designers to solve customer problems. You will work directly with our SVP Product Engineering Daniel.

You will:

  • Shape company and product strategy alongside our SVP of Product Engineering. It's a genuine partnership: you'll develop the vision for where Checkly goes next, decide where we play in the AI testing, monitoring, and observability landscape and where we don't, and turn that into a direction. You build the strategy with us, not execute someone else's.

  • Shape Checkly's point of view on reliability in an AI-native world: how teams monitor AI-generated code, agent-driven workflows, and LLM-backed features

  • Lead initiatives across Product Engineering, Sales and Marketing, and represent Checkly directly to customers and in developer communities.

  • Live in the product and the problem. Empathy for DevOps, SRE and Platform Engineering isn't a line item. It's the job.

  • You ship with AI where it helps and know when not to. You don't just talk about it.

What you should have

  • You've built software before this. You're an ex-engineer, ex-founder, or ex-solutions engineer who has written real code and shipped real things, and now you want to own the product. This one's non-negotiable: you should be able to reason about APIs, MCPs, CLIs, and how systems fit together without a translator.

  • You've worked in a startup, not just a big company. You're comfortable with ambiguity, small teams, and owning outcomes end to end. You don't need a big-company machine around you to be effective.

  • You've built technical products, ideally developer tools. Adjacent technical products count. Experience in monitoring or observability is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

  • New to the PM title? That's fine. If you're coming from a founding or solutions-engineering seat and want to go all-in on product, we want to hear from you.

  • You're technical enough to be dangerous with AI tooling. You can prototype in code, throw together a mock, or pressure-test technical viability yourself when it moves things forward.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. Need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment.

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

  • We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

  • We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

  • We are lean, so you own the boring parts too. There is no PM ops layer to delegate the unglamorous work to. You will do strategy one hour and clean up a messy spec the next.

  • We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

  • Customer signals come first, and most of the time they beat your gut. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up. Earn it by making customers happy, and then there is room for the moonshots. If you want to lead with your own bold bets, you will find this frustrating.

Benefits

  • Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

  • Remote-first, flexible work hours, async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture

  • Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won’t get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

  • Stock options

  • 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

  • Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Co-working budget or home office setup

  • Annual company kickoffs

  • Employee & contractor options

Find out more here.

What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is (depending on seniority and skills):

  • €83k - €120k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

  • €75k - €105k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

Apply

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook and open-sourced our employee handbook. There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

Compensation: €75K – €120K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

  • Similar cost of market as Germany, UK, France etc • €83K – €120K • Offers Equity
  • Similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc • €75K – €105K • Offers Equity

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’ collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Learn more at superhuman.com.

Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Growth team, where you will shape the end-to-end experience that brings new users into the Superhuman ecosystem and drives meaningful activation, retention, and expansion. You will partner closely with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to design experiences that are both delightful and measurably effective.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Own the design of key growth surfaces including onboarding, activation flows, referral programs, and upgrade moments across Superhuman’s product suite

  • Design the full journey, not isolated touchpoints — connecting key user moments into a coherent end-to-end experience instead of optimizing screens in isolation

  • Translate quantitative and qualitative insights into clear, compelling design solutions that move growth metrics

  • Drive experimentation — define hypotheses, design A/B tests, and iterate rapidly based on results

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Growth PM, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to align on strategy and ship high-quality work

  • Contribute to and evolve Superhuman’s design system, ensuring consistency and quality at scale

  • Bring a sharp eye for craft, including typography, layout, and visual hierarchy. You will help elevate the quality bar of everything the team ships.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product design experience, with at least 2 years focused on growth, conversion, or lifecycle design

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design work with measurable business impact

  • Deep experience with experimentation and data-informed design decision-making

  • Proficiency in Figma and a working knowledge of prototyping tools

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills — you can articulate design rationale to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with high ambiguity

Support for you, professionally and personally

title: Teamleiter (m/w/d) Produktionscontrolling
description:
Ihre neue Herausforderung als Teamleiter (m/w/d) Produktionscontrolling

Sie kennen die Zahlen hinter einer Produktion und möchten künftig nicht nur analysieren, was passiert ist, sondern gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team mitgestalten, was als Nächstes kommt? Dann könnte diese Position gut zu Ihnen passen.

Als erfahrene:r Produktionscontroller (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung für ein kleines, erfahrenes Team und bleiben gleichzeitig nah am operativen Tagesgeschäft. Ihr fachliches Know-how ist bei uns ebenso gefragt wie Ihre Fähigkeit, Aufgaben zu strukturieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und die unterschiedlichen Stärken im Team zusammenzubringen.

Unser Produktionscontrolling ist eng mit den Abläufen unserer Produktionsstandorte verzahnt. SAP bildet dabei das Herzstück unserer täglichen Arbeit und die zentrale Datenbasis für Abrechnung, Kalkulation und Analyse. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team möchten wir unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und die Möglichkeiten von Digitalisierung und Automatisierung noch stärker nutzen. Sie schauen gemeinsam, wo neue Lösungen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen, Abläufe erleichtern und mehr Raum für die analytischen Aufgaben des Controllings ermöglichen.

Folgende Aufgaben erwarten Sie an unserem Standort in Hamburg-Wilhelmsburg:

  • Sie übernehmen die fachliche Führung und Weiterentwicklung unseres kleinen Teams im Produktionscontrolling, koordinieren Aufgaben und sorgen gemeinsam für verlässliche Abläufe im Tagesgeschäft.

  • Sie verantworten die Abrechnung unserer Produktionsaufträge für die Abpackbetriebe der CAFEA-Gruppe, analysieren die Ergebnisse und arbeiten dabei eng mit unseren Produktionsstandorten zusammen.

  • Sie behalten Herstellkosten, Bestände sowie die Auftrags- und Kostenstellenrechnung im Blick und stellen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen eine verlässliche Datenbasis in SAP sicher.

  • Sie verantworten Kalkulationsläufe sowie relevante Sonderauswertungen und interne Kalkulationen und leiten aus den Ergebnissen die passenden Fragestellungen und Handlungsbedarfe ab.

  • Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team entwickeln Sie Prozesse, Auswertungen und unser Berichtswesen weiter und nutzen Digitalisierung und Automatisierung dort, wo sie die tägliche Arbeit sinnvoll unterstützen.

  • Darüber hinaus bringen Sie Ihr Know-How in standortübergreifende CAFEA-Projekte ein und arbeiten mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen.

Was Sie mitbringen

Sie sind fachlich gerne mittendrin, können gleichzeitig den Überblick behalten und haben Freude daran, Menschen, Zahlen und Prozesse zusammenzubringen? Dann passen Sie möglicherweise ziemlich gut zu uns.

Ob Ihr beruflicher Weg über ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium, eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung oder über mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung geführt hat, ist für uns dabei weniger entscheidend. Wichtig ist uns, dass Sie über fundierte Erfahrung im Controlling, idealerweise im Produktions- oder Werksumfeld, verfügen und betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge sicher beurteilen können.

Sie haben bereits erste Verantwortung für andere übernommen, beispielsweise als fachliche Führungskraft, Stellvertretung, Projektleitung oder in einem kleinen Team? Perfekt. Sie müssen bei uns keine langjährige Führungskarriere mitbringen. Viel wichtiger ist, dass Sie gerne Verantwortung übernehmen, Orientierung geben, zuhören und Ihr Wissen mit anderen teilen.

Unser Angebot

  • Digitalisierung gemeinsam gestalten: Wir möchten die Möglichkeiten neuer Technologien künftig noch stärker für unser Produktionscontrolling nutzen. Dabei setzen wir auf Lösungen, die zu unseren Prozessen und vor allem zu den Menschen passen, die täglich mit ihnen arbeiten.

  • Bei uns erwartet Sie nicht nur ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz, sondern auch eine langfristige Perspektive in einem international tätigen Familienunternehmen. Sie erhalten eine attraktive Vergütung, ergänzt durch Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld sowie regelmäßige Gehaltsanpassungen.

  • Wir möchten, dass Sie sich bei uns langfristig wohlfühlen und Ihre Arbeit flexibel gestalten können. Deshalb bieten wir Ihnen moderne Arbeitsbedingungen mit Gleitzeit, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche mobil zu arbeiten.

  • Gemeinsam wachsen: Wir fördern Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und externe Qualifizierungsangebote. Bei uns erhalten Sie Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung für spannende Projekte und Produkte zu übernehmen.

  • Auch außerhalb des Arbeitsplatzes möchten wir etwas zurückgeben: Sie profitieren von Zuschüssen zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, JobRad, vermögenswirksamen Leistungen, Deutschlandticket sowie vergünstigten Sport- und Gesundheitsangeboten über machtfit.

  • Karriere mit Geschmack: Sie erhalten monatliche Freikontingente, damit Sie auch nach der Arbeit erstklassigen Kaffee, Cappuccino und Trinkschokoladen genießen können.

  • Damit nicht nur unsere Produkte überzeugen, sondern auch Ihr Arbeitsalltag angenehm bleibt, wird in unserer betriebseigenen Kantine täglich frisch gekocht.

  • Dank unserer Kooperation mit dem Fürstenberg Institut erhalten Sie und Ihre Familienangehörigen Zugang zu professioneller und vertraulicher Beratung – bei beruflichen, privaten oder familiären Themen.

  • Unsere Mitarbeitenden liegen uns am Herzen. Neben den vielfältigen Angeboten gehören auch kleine Aufmerksamkeiten zu Geburtstagen, Ostern, Nikolaus oder Weihnachten bei uns einfach dazu.

Dürfen wir uns kurz vorstellen?

Familiär. International. Langfristig.

Besondere Qualität entsteht, wenn Tradition und Moderne miteinander harmonieren. 

Wir gehen respektvoll, offen und hilfsbereit miteinander um und geben jeden Tag unser Bestes, um erstklassige Kaffee-Spezialitäten zu produzieren.

Bei der DEK arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen Umfeld und spüren zugleich die Vorteile eines inhabergeführten Familienunternehmens.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Your mission

We are looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial Chief of Staff (f/m/d) to join the leadership team at deeploi.

In this role, you act as a strategic and operational partner to the CEO, driving cross-functional alignment, owning our financial steering, and making sure decisions are taken and executed across the company.

You combine sharp financial judgment with organisational excellence, acting as a bridge between strategy, finance and execution, as we build deeploi into a company with sustainable, profitable growth.

This is a highly visible role with a wide scope. Wherever a topic matters and has no clear home, you take it, own it end to end, and drive it to a result. You set a high bar for yourself and the people around you.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own strategic projects: Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives from first structure to final delivery.
  • Shape our commercial model: Drive how we position, package and price our product as we expand our SaaS offering and open up new go-to-market tiers.

Your profile

  • 5+ years of experience in consulting, investment or strategic and finance roles in a startup or scale-up, for example as a Chief of Staff, in a founder’s office, or in a senior finance role.

  • A real appetite to grab topics, take full accountability and drive them end to end, without waiting for someone to hand you a plan. You own what is unclear, unowned, and what everyone avoids.
  • Hands-on and entrepreneurial, with the detail orientation to push until something is excellent and the standards to raise the bar around you.
  • Excellent strategic thinking and communication: you translate between strategy, finance and operations, and challenge constructively at senior level.
  • Comfortable in a high performance culture with fast pace, changing priorities and broad responsibility.

Why us?

  • A key role in the leadership team with real ownership, impact and visibility, working directly alongside both Founders on the topics that decide where deeploi goes next.
  • Join a B2B SaaS company backed by Atomico, Cherry Ventures and other leading investors.
  • Competitive compensation package including virtual equity (VSOP).
  • Well-equipped offices in Berlin and Munich, plus benefits such as Urban Sports Club/EGYM or a public transport ticket and Corporate Benefits.

title: Founding Lead Engineer — AI & Workflow Automation
description:
Founding Lead Engineer — AI & Workflow Automation

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and leading companies. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs, we combine early-stage capital with a hands-on Venture Studio team across product, engineering, growth, talent and fundraising.

We’re now building a new venture tackling one of Germany’s biggest labour-market challenges: how to find, engage and hire skilled workers at scale.

We’re looking for a hands-on Lead Engineer with founder ambitions to build the first product from scratch, with the opportunity to become the venture’s Technical Co-Founder.

The opportunity

Recruiting skilled workers is still remarkably manual. Candidates are found across fragmented channels, contacted via WhatsApp or phone, qualified one by one, matched against roles and repeatedly chased for missing information.

We believe a large part of this workflow can be fundamentally redesigned using AI, conversational interfaces and automation.

You would build the first version: from candidate acquisition and qualification to matching, follow-up and integrations into existing recruiting workflows.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong full-stack engineer able to build independently from zero to working product

  • Experience automating messy, real-world workflows

  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM / AI-agent functionality to users

  • Comfortable connecting APIs, databases, messaging tools and third-party systems

  • Product-minded: you care about whether technology actually removes work and improves conversion

  • High ownership and entrepreneurial ambition — whether as a founder, early engineer, freelancer or technical operator

  • Familiarity with the DACH market; German strongly preferred

Particularly relevant

Experience with recruitment or HR tech, ATS/CRM integrations, WhatsApp, voice AI, n8n/Make, matching systems, marketplaces or workflow-heavy SaaS would be highly relevant.

What we offer

You’ll build the company from day one with capital and hands-on support from Founders Factory, working alongside an experienced venture team and with access to our network of founders, operators, corporate partners and investors.

This is an opportunity to build first, validate quickly and potentially step in as Technical Co-Founder of an independent venture-backed company.

title: Associate Privacy Consultant – SMB (m/f/d)
description:
YOUR JOB

Do you want to work on privacy topics where your expertise has visible customer impact, not just theoretical relevance? As an Associate Privacy Consultant, you take ownership of an established customer base and help companies turn GDPR requirements into clear, pragmatic and scalable privacy practices. You will work at the intersection of privacy, SaaS and AI enabled consulting, advising customers hands-on while shaping how modern privacy consulting can become smarter, faster and more impactful. If you bring strong data protection knowledge, customer instinct and the drive to raise the bar in a high ownership environment, then join us on our journey.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • You advise and support your own customer base on data protection, combining privacy expertise with smart use of our AI-powered platform., having a strong focus on retention, customer health and long-term value creation.

  • You translate complex GDPR and privacy topics into clear, pragmatic guidance that helps customers make confident business decisions.

  • You help customers use DataGuard as their central privacy hub and actively drive platform adoption, engagement and monthly active usage.

  • You use AI tools thoughtfully in privacy related workflows and critically review AI generated outputs based on your subject matter expertise.

  • You collaborate with privacy, automation and product stakeholders to share customer insights and contribute to more scalable, tech enabled consulting workflows.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • Real ownership of an established customer base from day one

  • A steep learning curve through hands-on advisory work with diverse privacy customers

  • The chance to work at the intersection of privacy, SaaS and AI enabled consulting

  • High visibility in a business critical, customer-facing role with direct impact on retention, adoption and expansion

  • Close collaboration with experienced privacy consultants, automation experts and product stakeholders

  • Structured onboarding, continuous learning opportunities and support for relevant certifications

  • A training budget of 1,500, access to personal coaching and support for certifications such as TÜV Datenschutzbeauftragter, CIPP/E or AIGP

  • A collaborative, international team that values curiosity, ownership and pragmatic problem solving

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in privacy consulting, customer advisory, audits or handling privacy related customer requests.

  • Strong GDPR and privacy knowledge, ideally combined with a legal, business law or comparable privacy focused background.

  • Ability to turn complex privacy requirements into simple, structured and customer-friendly recommendations.

  • Ability to improve efficiency in a dynamic customer environment, spot opportunities to create more value, and stay focused even when priorities shift.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership and the ability to connect the dots between customer needs, platform usage and business impact.

  • Curiosity to AI tools and automation, paired with the judgment to review AI generated privacy content critically.

  • Native level fluency in German, strong professional English skills

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

#LI-DNI

Challenge everything. "It can't be done" means "You haven't figured it out yet. Go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.

Schranken, Papiertickets, Parkscheiben – das war gestern. Heute bauen wir smarte Mobility Hubs, morgen die größten Enterprise-Deals der Parkbranche. Dafür suchen wir keinen Farmer, der bestehende Accounts hegt, sondern einen echten Hunter: Als eine:r unserer ersten Senior Account Executives im brandneuen Enterprise-Team baust Du unsere Enterprise-Sales-Motion in Deutschland komplett neu auf: Zielaccounts, Ansprache-Strategie, erster unterschriebener Vertrag, alles mit Deiner Handschrift. Im Zentrum steht eine klar definierte Named Account List (NAL) der wichtigsten Enterprise-Player Deutschlands, zu denen Du Dir proaktiv den Weg zu den relevanten Entscheider:innen bahnst, Hand in Hand mit unserem Marketing-Team und dessen ABM-Kampagnen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Geschäftsführung, unserem VP Sales sowie unserem neuen Head of Enterprise Sales zusammen.


Was ist Deine Aufgabe?

  • Du baust die Enterprise-Sales-Motion in Deutschland von null auf. Prozesse, Ansprache-Strategie und Playbooks entstehen mit Dir.

  • Du entwickelst und bespielst unsere Named Account List (NAL) und verschaffst Dir über Multi-Threading Zugang zu allen relevanten Entscheider:innen.

  • Du gehst outbound first auf Kundenjagd: Kaltakquise, Netzwerken, Events, gemeinsame ABM-Kampagnen mit Marketing. Leads wartest Du nicht ab, Du machst sie.

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales-Cycle: von Video-Call und Vor-Ort-Demo bis Vertragsabschluss und Übergabe an unser Operations-Team.

  • Du berätst bis auf C-Level zu Verträgen, Technik, Mobilitätskonzepten, Ausschreibungen und Partnerschaften und gibst Kundenfeedback direkt an unser Produkt-Team weiter.

  • Du baust gemeinsam mit Geschäftsführung, VP Sales und Head of Enterprise Sales das Team auf und coachst künftig auch (Junior) Account Executives.

  • Du repräsentierst Peter Park bei strategischen Terminen und Branchenevents.


Deine Fähigkeiten:

  • Waschechter Hunter & Connector: Beziehungen auf allen Ebenen aufbauen ist für Dich kein Aufwand, sondern Hobby. Du bist pragmatisch und street smart.

  • Riesige Resilience: Lange Sales-Cycles und Rückschläge spornen Dich an, statt Dich zu bremsen.

  • Senior Room Presence: Vorstandsetagen sind für Dich Wohnzimmer, nicht Bühnenangst.

  • Influencer & Persuader: Du überzeugst mit Substanz und Charisma, nicht mit Druck.

  • Komplexität schreckt Dich nicht, sie reizt Dich. Du schneidest Dich durch wie ein heißes Messer durch Butter.

  • Nachgewiesene quantitative Erfolgsbilanz im Knacken von Quotas und Greenfield-Territorien. Net-New-Logos statt warmer Leads. Top-Performer-Auszeichnungen? Gerne erzählen.

  • Sattelfest in MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale & Co., mit einer CRM-Pipeline, die nicht lügt (Hubspot, Salesforce).

  • 5+ Jahre B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Enterprise-/Named-Account-Erfahrung; Erfahrung mit Hardware+Software-Lösungen (IoT, Sensorik) ist ein Plus, kein Muss.

  • Erfahrung mit Account-Based Marketing oder enger Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing-Teams an Zielaccount-Strategien.

  • Unternehmerischer Kopf, der mit Ambiguität tanzt statt zu zögern. Ein Studium ist nett, aber kein Muss.

  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 



Work Setup:

  • 40 Stunden/Woche (Vertrauensbasis)

  • Arbeitsort: München (3 Tage Office / 2 Tage remote) oder 100 % remote (deutschlandweit) mit regelmäßigen Trips ins Büro nach München. 

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

  • Reisebereitschaft: ca. 50 % (deutschlandweit) für Termine mit Deinen Target Accounts

  • Neu aufgebautes Enterprise-Team. Du gehörst zu den Ersten

  • Reporting an unseren neuen Head of Sales, Enterprise


Welche Vorteile bietet mir Peter Park?

So ticken wir! Passt das zu Dir?

  • Own & Prioritize: „Nicht mein Job“ gibt's bei uns nicht. Du übernimmst und ziehst durch.

  • Think Big: Wir denken in Portfolios, nicht in Einzeldeals.

  • Bias for Action: Wir entscheiden schnell und justieren im Gehen nach.

  • Have Backbone, Disagree & Commit: Du sagst früh, was Du denkst und ziehst mit, wenn entschieden ist.


Du erfüllst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt auf dieser Liste, brennst aber für diese Rolle? Bewirb Dich trotzdem – wir schätzen Persönlichkeit und Lernbereitschaft mindestens so sehr wie einen perfekten Lebenslauf.

title: AI Automation Engineer – Marketing & Operations Consulting (m/w/d) in Stuttgart, Hamburg oder Berlin – Hybrid
description:
Ihre Aufgaben

Um unser Business weiter auszubauen, suchen wir engagierte Kolleg*innen – diesmal für eine Rolle, die es bei uns so noch nie gab.
Rund um KI und Automatisierung haben wir schon einiges angestoßen – und suchen dich, um diese Schritte spürbar zu beschleunigen. Statt Tool-Wildwuchs entwickeln wir eigene integrierte Systeme auf Basis von KI und Automatisierung für Vertrieb und Operations. Daneben wachsen KI-Assistenten, automatisierte Auswertungen aus Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn und unseren SEO-Tools sowie Reportings, die sich selbst schreiben und über Human in the Loop besser werden. Ein großer Teil der Kundenarbeit unserer über 60 Kolleg*innen ist und bleibt trotzdem Handarbeit.
Du liest eine API-Dokumentation und hast zwei Stunden später einen laufenden Prototyp? Du verstehst, warum eine SEA-Managerin anders auf Daten schaut als ein SEO – und kannst einem Kollegen ohne technischen Hintergrund erklären, wie er das Ergebnis ab morgen selbst bedient? Du denkst KI nicht als Spielerei, sondern als System, das dokumentiert, datenschutzkonform und im Betrieb stabil sein muss? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Zum Ausbau unseres AI- und Automatisierungsbereichs suchen wir dich als AI Automation Engineer – Marketing & Operations Consulting (m/w/d).
Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI- und Automatisierungssysteme, mit denen unsere Teams täglich arbeiten – und bringst dieselbe Kompetenz in unsere Kundenprojekte ein, von Marketing-Technology-Fragen bis zur Beratung rund um Automatisierung. Deine Arbeitsweise ist AI Engineering gepaart mit Vibe Coding: Du weißt, wie man ein System sauber aufsetzt, betreibt und absichert – und du kommst trotzdem in Tagen statt Quartalen zum lauffähigen Ergebnis, weil du KI als Werkzeug beim Bauen selbstverständlich einsetzt. Du verbindest Werkzeuge miteinander, schaffst die Datengrundlage, auf der diese Systeme überhaupt erst sinnvoll arbeiten, und befähigst Kolleg*innen wie Kund*innen, damit zu arbeiten. So werden aus Möglichkeiten messbar eingesparte Stunden.
Infos unter www.klickpiloten.de.
 
Deine Aufgaben

  • Bauen und betreiben: Du entwickelst unsere internen KI-Systeme weiter – Assistenten, Agenten, automatisierte Workflows – vom ersten Prototyp bis in den produktiven Betrieb. Du baust selbst, mit Claude Code, Cursor oder womit auch immer du am schnellsten zum Ergebnis kommst. Und du hältst am Leben, was du gebaut hast: Monitoring, Fehlerfälle, Kosten, Qualität der Ergebnisse. Schnell gebaut heißt bei uns nicht wegwerfbar.
  • Systeme verbinden, Kontext schaffen: Du verdrahtest unsere Werkzeuge miteinander – Google Ads API, Meta Marketing API, SEO-Tools, unser CRM, Google Workspace, MCP-Server. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere KI-Systeme mit den richtigen Daten arbeiten. Das ist der eigentliche Hebel: Ein Modell ist nur so gut wie der Kontext, den es bekommt.
  • Kundenprojekte und Marketing Technology: Du berätst unsere Kund*innen zu ihrem Marketing-Technology-Stack: welche Systeme sie wirklich brauchen, wie Shop, CRM und Werbeplattformen zusammenspielen, wo Datenfeeds und Schnittstellen hingehören. Du konzipierst kundenspezifische Automatisierungen und KI-Anwendungsfälle und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unseren Fachteams um – von der Machbarkeitsfrage im Pitch bis zur Lösung, die beim Kunden läuft.
  • Consulting rund um Marketing und Automatisierung: Du führst Workshops bei Kund*innen durch, findest heraus, wo in deren Prozessen Zeit und Datenqualität verloren gehen, und übersetzt das in konkrete Maßnahmen. Was sich bei uns intern bewährt, entwickelst du zu einem Beratungsangebot weiter, das wir verkaufen können.
  • Tracking, Consent und Analytics: Du baust Tracking- und Analytics-Setups auf, bringst das Consent Management sauber dazu und konsolidierst vor allem Marketingdaten aus ihren vielen Quellen – Werbeplattformen, SEO-Tools, Shop, CRM – zu einem Bild, das trägt. Du automatisierst, was daraus regelmäßig entstehen muss: die Präsentation, die sich aus Kampagnendaten selbst zusammenbaut, das Reporting, das Dienstagfrüh fertig im Sheet steht. Und du bleibst nicht bei der Zahl stehen, sondern liest aus den Daten, was sie über Kampagnen, Zielgruppen und Budgets sagen, und machst daraus eine Empfehlung, mit der Teams und Kund*innen etwas anfangen können.
  • Qualitätschecks und Audits automatisieren: Du automatisierst unsere internen Qualitätssicherungen – Kampagnen-, Tracking- und Account-Setups werden regelmäßig maschinell geprüft, statt dass jemand Checklisten abarbeitet. Abweichungen fallen auf, bevor eine Kundin sie bemerkt. Aus wiederkehrenden Fehlerbildern machst du Regeln, die dauerhaft mitlaufen.
  • Enablement und Coaching: Du schulst und begleitest die Teams, fortlaufend und nah an der konkreten Arbeit statt im einmaligen Workshop. Du schreibst Playbooks, Anleitungen und Dokumentation, die auch jemand versteht, der nicht dabei war. Und du erkennst, welche Handarbeit sich zu automatisieren lohnt und welche man besser Handarbeit sein lässt.
  • Compliance, Datenschutz und Vertraulichkeit: Du entscheidest mit, welche KI-Anbieter und Modelle wir einsetzen und wo Kundendaten dabei landen dürfen. DSGVO, EU AI Act und unsere Vertraulichkeitszusagen bringst du in eine Form, mit der das Team im Alltag arbeiten kann. Du dokumentierst unsere Systeme so, dass sie prüfbar und übergabefähig bleiben.
  • Schnittstelle nach außen: Wo wir nicht selbst bauen, steuerst du externe Entwickler*innen, Dienstleister und Tool-Anbieter – von der Anforderung über die Abnahme bis zum Betrieb. Auch auf Kundenseite bist du die Person, die mit IT-Abteilungen und Technikpartnern auf Augenhöhe spricht und zwischen Marketing-Anforderung und technischer Umsetzung übersetzt.
  • Innovation: Du beobachtest, was sich bei Modellen, Agenten-Frameworks und Marketing-APIs bewegt, bewertest neue Features nüchtern und entscheidest, was davon bei uns Produktivbetrieb verdient – und was nicht.
Was diese Stelle nicht ist
Damit wir uns gegenseitig keine Zeit nehmen:
  • Keine reine Beratungsrolle. Du berätst Kund*innen, aber du baust jede Woche auch selbst.
  • Kein klassischer Entwicklerjob. Du sitzt nicht im abgeschirmten Sprint, sondern zwischen Fachteams und Kund*innen.
  • Kein Prompt-Engineering-Job. Prompts sind ein Werkzeug, nicht das Produkt.


Anforderungen

Dein Profil

  • Du hast in den letzten Jahren Automatisierungen oder KI-Anwendungen gebaut, die produktiv im Einsatz waren. Zeig uns zwei oder drei davon.
  • Du arbeitest mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung, Stichwort Vibe Coding – und kannst gleichzeitig beurteilen, was dabei herauskommt: TypeScript oder Python, REST-APIs, OAuth, Git, Datenbanken. Du musst keine Software-Architektin sein, aber ein Stacktrace darf dich nicht abschrecken und generierter Code geht bei dir nicht ungeprüft in Produktion.
  • Praxis mit LLM-APIs: Tool Use, strukturierte Ausgaben, Embeddings, das Bewerten von Ergebnisqualität und ein Gefühl für Token-Kosten.
  • Digitalmarketing-Verständnis. Du weißt, was eine Kampagnenstruktur ist, was ein Sichtbarkeitsindex aussagt und warum Attribution kompliziert ist.
  • Sicherheit in Web Analytics: Du kannst ein sauberes, einwilligungskonformes Tracking-Setup aufbauen, Datenquellen zusammenführen und aus dem Ergebnis eine Empfehlung ableiten – nicht nur ein Dashboard bauen.
  • Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make oder Zapier – und ein Urteil darüber, wann man sie einsetzt und wann man besser selbst baut.
  • Du bist gern vor Kund*innen: Du kannst eine technische Lösung so präsentieren, dass auch die Marketingleitung versteht, was sie davon hat, und sagst auch mal ab, wenn eine Idee sich nicht rechnet.
  • Du kannst erklären: verständlich, geduldig, ohne Fachjargon, wo er nicht nötig ist.
  • Du dokumentierst, ohne dass man dich darum bitten muss.
  • Deutsch als Muttersprache und sicheres Englisch für jede Dokumentation.
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Terminen bei Kund*innen und an unseren anderen Standorten.
Ob du das auf Mid- oder Senior-Level machst, klären wir gemeinsam. Uns interessiert, was du gebaut hast, nicht wie lange du dabei bist.

Nice to have
  • Praxis mit der Google Ads API oder der Meta Marketing API.
  • Erfahrung mit MCP-Servern oder eigenen Agenten-Setups.
  • Google Apps Script, Slides API, Sheets API.
  • Erfahrung mit SEO-Tools wie Sistrix, Semrush oder DataForSEO.
  • Analytics-Stack: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Server-Side Tagging, BigQuery, Looker Studio.
  • Weitere Marketing-Technology-Erfahrung: Consent-Management-Plattformen wie Usercentrics oder Cookiebot, CDPs oder Marketing-Automation-Systeme.
  • Agenturhintergrund, damit dich Kundenprojekt-Realität nicht überrascht.
  • Berührung mit DSGVO-Themen, Auftragsverarbeitung oder IT-Sicherheit.
Wir bieten

  • Ein Budget für Tools und Modelle, das zu dieser Arbeit passt, plus Zeit zum Ausprobieren
  • Und natürlich Tokens – mehr als du einsetzen kannst ;-)
  • Großartiger Teamspirit, kollegiale Atmosphäre, flache Hierarchien
  • Spannende Projekte mit bekannten Marken aus E-Commerce, Industrie und Consumer Brands
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice/Remote-Optionen
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Deutschland-Ticket-Zuschuss, Firmenrabatt und Zuschuss zur Urban Sports Club/Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft
  • Moderner zentraler Arbeitsplatz in Stuttgart, Hamburg oder Berlin

title: Head of Product (all genders)
description:
Kertos Intro

Kertos is the fastest-growing compliance startup in Europe.

Following our €14M Series A, backed by leading VCs and business angels, we are building the compliance engine for Europe – faster, smarter, and more automated than ever.
With customers like Enpal, Flink, Personio, and Blacklane, leading companies trust our AI-native platform that automates compliance, scales effortlessly, and makes organizations audit-ready in record time.

The market is growing by 20% every year, fueled by regulations like GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and the AI Act. We are perfectly positioned to establish Kertos as the European compliance champion.

There has never been a better moment to join our team.

Come shape the future of compliance in Europe with us.


Your purpose at Kertos

As Head of Product, you own Kertos's product vision and roadmap, and you're joining at a genuinely pivotal moment. The category is being redrawn: compliance is shifting from software as a service to service as software, where AI and automation do the work wherever they can and our compliance experts focus on the judgment calls that still need a human. Few companies get to shape a product at the point where that shift is actually happening. You will.

That means the roadmap in front of you is wide open. There are more good directions to take the product than we can pursue at once, across the segments we serve today and the ones we're growing into, and a real part of the job is choosing where to place the bets. You'll work closely with our compliance experts to understand exactly what clients need, and decide with your team and engineering where the line between automation and human judgment sits today, with the mandate to push it forward quarter after quarter as AI takes on more of the work.

This role sits at the center of the product organization and value creation. You set the roadmap across squads, and you lead and grow the product team, partnering closely with our compliance experts and building around their knowledge, their needs, and their day-to-day work. You're accountable for the roadmap, for how the product team operates, and for outcomes clients can feel directly: time saved, risk reduced, audits passed.

Your responsibilities

  • Set the product vision, defining where Kertos product goes next, the shift from compliance software clients operate themselves to a service that delivers compliance outcomes for them, and turn that vision into a roadmap built around client value, not just feature velocity.
  • Partner closely with our compliance experts to learn what actually creates value for them and our customers, and work with our Development Team to turn that expertise into a product that makes their work faster and clients' outcomes better.
  • Continue to develop and mentor four product managers and two designers as the team scales, set the standards for how they run discovery and shipping, and make sure they grow into stronger PMs under you.
  • Optimize the discovery process and work closely with compliance experts, design and engineering to understand problems deeply, validate ideas with real clients before building, and ship improvements that move a client's compliance outcome.
  • Understand needs of customers, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing so product bets translate into revenue, retention, and measurable value for clients, especially as features move from "helps you do compliance" to "does the compliance work for you."
  • Own the roadmap, setting priorities independently, and aligning them with technical leads, our customer advisory board, key clients, and the leadership team.
  • Use data to define what success looks like for each initiative in terms clients would recognize, such as “time saved”, “risk mitigated”, “time to audit readiness”, and work with Marketing and Customer Success to turn usage data into the next round of decisions.



The skills, motivation, and mentality you should bring

  • You've led product strategy in B2B SaaS as a Head of Product or similar, at a startup, scale-up, or an agile team inside a larger company and ideally have taken a product from idea through GA more than once.
  • You've hired, mentored, and managed product managers before, and know how to set clear expectations and give feedback that actually helps.
  • You successfully partner with compliance or legal experts who aren't engineers and turn their knowledge into product requirements
  • You are passionate about AI and enjoy using it to define new product processes
  • You are an ambitious and driven high-performer that wants to have a high impact on changing how compliance work gets done, excited about new user flows and AI-driven automation and is excited to take our compliance service & software product to series B ready.
  • Big plus if you bring technical engineering expertise that helps you to discuss frontend, backend, and cloud architecture and you can successfully turn complex technical and compliance topics into clear direction for engineering, sales, leadership, and customers.
  • Familiarity with GRC, information security, or privacy topics would be a great plus point, too.
  • German language skills are required for this position.


Why Kertos

  • You are Kertos: Don’t like something? Could be done better? You have the freedom to push things forward and contribute to making Kertos a great place to work
  • Unique opportunity: Join the growing team of one of Europe’s most promising early stages companies and to work directly with our COO Joe
  • European funding in the millions: The EU has funded our AI research with a total of over 2 million euros
  • Regular Feedback: We foster an open feedback culture and support your growth with regular 1-on-1 meetings
  • Full Flexibility: Whether at the Berlin office, our Munich HQ or at your home office – we are flexible, and you'll be happy
  • Keep growing: To boost your professional and personal growth, we provide you with a Personal Development Budget of 1.500€ per year
  • Cutting Edge Technology: Leading VCs have invested in our vision to revolutionize how compliance measures are handled sustainably
  • Mental Health: We've partnered with nilo to prioritize your well-being, offering personalized mental health support for all employees
  • For Sports Enthusiasts: We subsidize your Wellpass membership for your physical fitness for a better work-life balance
  • Steep learning curve: With us you get full responsibility from day 1, push topics forward independently and thus learn a lot
  • Strong onboarding: No idea about compliance and its automation? No problem, we'll turn you into an expert and provide you with an onboarding buddy
  • Teamwork Makes the Dream Work: We are a strong team that supports each other, and we also have a lot of fun together beyond work and across different locations


Sounds like you are the one we’ve been looking for?

Perfect, let's have a chat! Just send in your CV. We are excited to meet you soon.
In case you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our People & Culture team. We're happy to answer all your questions.

title: Talent Partner [Technical]
description:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

Why this role matters

We're doubling the size of Engineering, Product, and Design year-on-year, and the biggest constraint on how fast we build is how fast we hire. You'll join the Talent team as the connective tissue between EPD leadership and the best engineers in Europe — One day you’ll be running a sharp headhunting process process for a Staff Engineer and the next; pushing a high-volume inbound pipeline through with the same rigor. Both are equally important.

Attio is for people who own their role, learn quickly, are endlessly curious, and find happiness in delivering consistently brilliant outcomes that push the company forward. We love working with people who are passionate about working this way and will do whatever it takes to get things done.

We're particularly keen to hear from people with:

  • A track record of recruiting engineers into a startup or scale-up with a genuinely high bar — agency-side or in-house

  • Experience hiring software engineers who'd pass a tough technical bar, not just filling a requisition

  • Range across both ends of the funnel: targeted, hand-crafted outbound and high-volume inbound processing, without letting either slip

  • A real, hands-on AI-first approach to sourcing and screening — using modern tooling to work faster, not just talking about it

  • Time spent inside a high-growth environment where the team doubled year after year, and the process had to hold up under that pressure

Whether you've cut your teeth at a high-bar engineering recruitment agency, grown up inside a fast-scaling startup, or learned rigor at a big tech company, what matters more than your last logo is that you've done the reps — and you're ready to do a lot more of them here.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and run sourcing strategies for some of the hardest engineering roles in Europe

  • Own high-volume inbound processing without letting quality or candidate experience slip

  • Work on recruiting events, recruitment events and foster interest in Attio through your talent network and community

  • Bring an AI-first mindset to sourcing, screening, and process

  • Run processes end-to-end, from screening to offer management and admin to reporting

The attributes we're looking for

  • Resilient our bar is high. We only hire around 0.2% of the candidates that we source or review. You need to be genuinely fine with that ratio, not just tolerate it.

  • Resourceful the best people exist; our job is finding and reaching them, however unconventional the route.

  • Committed hiring managers need to trust that you're fully focused on raising the bar for the team, day in and day out.

  • Thoughtful given our trajectory, a role at Attio will be a genuinely meaningful step for the right person, but you can't assume that its right for everyone — we understand what candidates actually want before we tell them why we're a fit.

  • Hustle we're competing with the best, for the best. Your instincts, speed and innovative approach are often the difference between winning a candidate and losing them to someone else.

What does the hiring process look like?

We respond to candidates within 48 hours of every interview.

  1. Application review

  2. Hiring Manager interview - 30 minutes

  3. Case study / panel interview (two parts) - 1.5 hours

  4. Stakeholder interview with our VP of Engineering - 30 minutes

  5. Executive round with our CEO - 30 minutes

Most interviews are self-scheduled, but we're always on hand if you have questions along the way. By the offer stage, you may want to meet more of the team, see a demo, or ask us anything else.

What will an offer consist of?

  • A competitive salary

  • Equity in an early-stage company on an exceptional trajectory

  • Apple hardware and a budget for desk amenities

  • 25 days holiday plus local public holidays

  • Regular team events in London

  • Team off-sites in fun places (Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

  • Enhanced parental leave

title: Partnerships Associate
description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The role

Heidi Evidence is clinical decision support with no commercial influence: nothing shapes what a clinician sees except clinical quality. Getting there means earning the trust of the organisations that hold the world's clinical knowledge, the journals, publishers, guideline bodies, professional societies and universities, and running large information-gathering programs across the NHS. That is the work of this role.

You'll sit next to our founder across partnerships, evidence and strategic projects, and you'll own the machinery underneath them. Hundreds of contacts, documents, deadlines and follow-ups, all current. AI-agent workflows doing the repetitive multi-step parts of outreach at a scale no one could reach by hand, with you auditing what comes out and drawing the line where a human has to look. The role starts part-time and grows with what you show you can carry. It fits an F3 or F4 doctor who wants into health tech, product and partnerships without putting their NHS experience on a shelf.

This is a part-time role, with the potential to become full-time.

What you’ll do

  • Run information-gathering, outreach and partnership programs across NHS organizations, end to end.

  • Build the tracking systems that hold it together: contacts, documents, deadlines, responses, follow-ups, one place, always current.

  • Set up AI-agent workflows for the repetitive, multi-step parts of the work, then keep them running in production.

  • Audit what those agents produce. Find the failure modes, fix the workflow, decide where human review is non-negotiable.

  • Write to NHS teams, publishers, societies and universities in a register they trust.

  • Map the clinical knowledge landscape: who holds what, who decides, which conversations to open first.

  • Prepare founder-level partnership meetings, keep accurate notes and close every action.

  • Surface risks, gaps and decisions early. Short updates, no surprises.

If we’d worked together the last 6 weeks

  • You'd have designed an outreach wave to several hundred NHS trusts, handed the first pass to an agent workflow, and caught the small percentage it got wrong before anything left the building.

  • You'd have mapped the UK guideline and specialty society landscape, then told us which five conversations actually move Evidence forward.

  • You'd have joined a founder call with a major clinical publisher, written the notes and closed every action inside the week.

  • A tracker someone had outgrown would have been rebuilt properly, so nothing now waits on a person remembering.

  • You'd have found a manual process, automated it, and taught the team to run it without you.

What you’ll need

  • 2+ years owning complex operational, clinical or partnership work, though we care more about what you’ve shipped than years on the clock.

  • A romantic streak about software. You believe great products can transform someone’s day.

  • Fluency with AI tools that goes past using them. You’ve built agent workflows or automations other people now depend on, and you know their failure modes.

  • Composure across many open threads. Nothing you own drops, and you can tell which thread to pick up first.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Useful, not essential

  • Experience working in or closely with the NHS.

  • Medical training at FY2 level or beyond, particularly if you’re currently F3 or F4.

  • A current NHS affiliation and NHS.net address. Useful, not required, and any NHS account must be used in line with your organisation’s policies.

  • A feel for UK hospital workflows and how clinicians reach information at the point of care.

  • Familiarity with the clinical journals, publishers, guideline bodies, societies and universities that hold medical knowledge.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Join an established technology organisation providing managed IT services to some of the market's most recognised companies. Our client is looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to support customer environments across a varied and hands-on technical role.

The successful candidate will combine remote support with regular customer-site activity, working across infrastructure, Microsoft technologies, hardware, software and security.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide technical assistance to customers and act as a reliable point of contact.

  • Attend customer locations to diagnose faults, carry out repairs and complete scheduled maintenance.

  • Manage support incidents and requests through the company's ticketing system.

  • Provide customers with timely updates and ensure agreed service levels are maintained.

  • Escalate critical technical problems to Management when appropriate.

  • Review workload and priorities each day and take ownership of required actions.

  • Monitor customer infrastructure and system environments to ensure they remain operational and meet business requirements.

  • Deploy, test, maintain and troubleshoot hardware and software.

  • Accurately document technical work and maintain up-to-date service tickets.

  • Take ownership of urgent incidents, whether handled remotely or at a customer site.

Benefits

  • £30,000 - £40,000 per annum depending on experience.

  • 40 days' paid holiday annually.


You will need at least 5 years' experience in a relevant IT role, with a strong technical background covering:

  • Cyber Essentials and GDPR security implementation (mandatory).

  • Microsoft 365 and its core services, including Email, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive (mandatory).

  • Intune, RMM platforms and telephone/communications systems.

  • Network infrastructure and connectivity, including routers, switches, APs, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, VLANs and firewalls.

  • Working collaboratively with external suppliers and technical service providers.

  • IT processes, procedures and industry best practices.

  • Windows Server 2016, 2019 and 2022, including Group Policy and security configuration.

  • Azure administration and system implementations.

  • Windows 10, Windows 11 and Mac.

  • Client builds, imaging and deployment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with a strong customer-service mindset.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills and the ability to work independently.

title: IT Support & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Are you an experienced IT professional looking for a hands-on role within an international technology organisation? Our client is an established Managed Service Provider delivering IT support and infrastructure services to a range of well-known businesses.

They are looking for a proactive and technically capable engineer who is comfortable working directly with customers, resolving technical issues and supporting IT environments both remotely and on customer premises.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical assistance to customers and act as a trusted point of contact for support matters.

  • Visit customer sites to investigate and resolve technical issues, perform installations and undertake planned maintenance.

  • Manage incidents, requests and ongoing technical tasks through the Service Desk system.

  • Provide customers with regular updates and ensure tickets are progressed within agreed SLAs.

  • Escalate critical, complex or high-priority issues to Management when appropriate.

  • Organise daily workloads and ensure urgent and important tasks are dealt with accordingly.

  • Monitor customer environments and infrastructure to ensure systems remain reliable and meet business requirements.

  • Install, configure, test, maintain and repair IT hardware, software and related systems.

  • Maintain accurate ticket information and document technical work and outstanding actions.

  • Respond to major incidents and priority issues both remotely and at customer locations.

Benefits

  • £30,000 - £40,000 per annum, depending on experience.

  • 40 days' paid holiday annually.


The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 5 years' experience in a similar IT engineering role, with practical knowledge of:

  • Cyber Essentials and GDPR security standards, including configuration and implementation (mandatory).

  • Microsoft 365 services, including Email, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive (mandatory).

  • Microsoft Intune, RMM solutions and telephone platforms.

  • Network infrastructure installation and support, including routers, switches, wireless APs, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls and VLANs.

  • Working with external suppliers and service providers to resolve technical requirements.

  • Applying appropriate IT procedures, controls and industry best practices.

  • Windows Server 2016, 2019 and 2022, including Group Policy and security policies.

  • Azure administration and implementation.

  • Windows 10, Windows 11 and Mac operating systems.

  • Building, imaging and configuring different customer environments.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and a professional customer-facing manner.

  • The ability to analyse issues, troubleshoot effectively and work independently.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to contribute as part of a wider team.
